auth.sign_up.confirm_email.value: Account created. Open the confirmation link we emailed you, then sign in.

auth.sign_up.exists.value: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.sign_up.exists.description: Error on the web sign-up form when the email is already registered.

auth.sign_up.password_min.value: Password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.sign_up.password_min.description: Client-side validation error on the web sign-up form for a too-short password.

guest.banner.message.value: Guest mode — your data is saved only on this device.
guest.banner.message.description: Persistent thin banner shown across the web app while using it without an account (local-only storage).
